content.title: Conan Gray Earns His First No. 1 On Several Charts With An Old Smash
content.text: Conan Gray earns his first No. 1 on several charts in the U.K. as "Heather" debuts atop multiple rankings following its release on vinyl. ELMONT, NEW YORK - SEPTEMBER 07: Conan Gray attends the 2025 MTV Video Music Awards at UBS Arena on September 07, 2025 in Elmont, New York. (Photo by Mike Coppola/Getty Images for MTV)Getty Images for MTVA little more than half a decade ago, Conan Gray broke out with the single “Heather” after years of producing his signature style of indie pop music. The tune brought him to a number of charts all around the world for the first time, and it remains one of his most successful compositions. Years after it was first released, "Heather" debuts on multiple charts in the United KIngdom, where the cut manages to score the singer-songwriter his first leader on two tallies as it manages an impressive comeback.Conan Gray’s "Heather" Debuts at No. 1 in the U.K."Heather" debuts on two charts in the U.K., and it’s a champion on both of them. The track launches at No. 1 on the Official Vinyl Singles and Official Physical Singles tallies. The first of those two rosters looks only at the bestselling individual cuts that are available for sale on wax. Only a few years ago, most musicians didn’t bother pressing songs on vinyl, but the format has become massively popular again, and an important revenue stream for many artists. The Official Physical Singles rundown incorporates all purchases of singles on vinyl, as well as both CDs and cassettes, which are likewise popular once more.Conan Gray Earns His First No. 1 With "Heather"Gray collects his second career appearance on both tallies where "Heather" debuts this frame. He earns his first ruler, as "Heather" outpaces the No. 3 peak that “Sunset Season” reached after debuting five years ago, in March 2021.Conan Gray Beats Yaelokre, Squeeze and Elliott SmithThree tracks debut inside the top 10 of the Official Physical Singles chart this frame. Gray beats new arrivals from Yaelokre and Squeeze. The former launches "Hartebeest" at No. 3, while the latter’s "Trixies Pt. 1" opens at No. 5. Over on the Official Vinyl Singles chart, five tracks launch between Nos. 1 and 10. In addition to Gray, Yaelokre, and Squeeze, a pair of fan favorites from the late Elliott Smith appear on the tally for the first time. "Division Day" opens at No. 8, while "Pretty (Ugly Before)" comes in at No. 9.MORE FOR YOUConan Gray’s "Heather" Returns to the U.K.’s Sales Chart"Heather" can be found on one additional list, though it’s not new to that tally. Gray’s smash returns to the Official Singles Sales chart, landing on the roster for the first time in more than half a decade. "Heather" debuted on the Official Singles Sales roster in September 2020, when it opened at No. 89. Two weeks later, it bounded back and spent three frames on the tally, peaking at No. 69. "Heather" has not been seen on the list of the bestselling cuts of any genre or any language throughout the U.K. since October 2020. Email Address INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA - DECEMBER 05: (FOR EDITORIAL USE ONLY) Conan Gray performs onstage at iHeartRadio 102.7 KIIS FM's Jingle Ball 2025 presented by Capital One at Intuit Dome on December 05, 2025 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Amy Sussman/Getty Images for iHeartRadio)Getty Images for iHeartRadioConan Gray Recently Offered “Heather” for Sale on VinylGray sold a 12-inch single of "Heather," titled the Wishbone Edition, for a period of time in his online store. The $20 product, which included the original version of "Heather" on the A-side as well as a live take recorded in 2025 on the B-side, quickly sold out, and it’s clear that British fans purchased many of those records.Conan Gray’s "Heather" Remains His Biggest Hit"Heather" was selected as the sixth and final single from Gray’s debut album Kid Krow, which dropped in March 2020. Several other songs from the project, such as "Checkmate" and "Maniac," generated a lot of buzz about the rising indie figure, but it wasn’t until sometime later, when "Heather" went viral on TikTok, that it became his first true hit. "Heather" remains one of only two tracks by Gray to make it to the Official Singles chart, which lists the most consumed tunes in the U.K. The Kid Krow smash peaked at No. 17, and Gray wouldn’t score his second and, so far, only other win until July of 2025. Last summer, "Vodka Cranberry" opened at No. 93 and then quickly slipped away.
